items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...it's a name like Buddy Gold and it's only fair.

ctx.x: The dog is sleeping, the bird is getting recorded for posterity. I mean, after all, it's a name like Buddy Gold and it's only fair.
Steve Woodrow played with the Triangle Band, with the Majaudi. And when he died, I thought it was Sam, our name. Yeah. It's like that. But she died. I just died a couple of weeks ago, a month ago.
